timing_mismatch_detected.original_behavior: ovation_all[omni_idx] applies 5-minute OMNI array index to a 1-minute OVATION array and selects a single OVATION frame, rather than interval mean; DDPM conditioned on a nearest midpoint 5-minute OMNI record
timing_mismatch_detected.affected_outputs: Uploaded Figure6/7 triptych reconstructions and panels (b,c); do not claim final time-consistent figures
timing_mismatch_detected.unaffected_results: The separately executed heldout benchmark and SSUSI PSD diagnostics explicitly use acquisition-interval OMNI/OVATION means

synthetic_vs_observed: Real SSUSI benchmark uses 12 actively selected held-out MLT sectors nested within just 2 EDR events; not independent event-level replication.

heldout_benchmark.qualifier: Means over correlated/partly overlapping held-out sectors; case-to-case heterogeneity and active-sector selection constrain generality.

gradient_psd.inference: Pooled segment CIs/Wilcoxon p-values and pixel-level KS p-values are not event-independent and must not be presented as significance across events.
gradient_psd.missing_from_upload: New per-event psd_comparison.csv and psd_segment_metrics.csv are required to update the manuscript with validated event-level differences.

status: Real heldout benchmark and gradient/PSD recomputation received. Time-corrected Figure6/7 inference not yet run; manuscript and reviewer response remain provisional for that point.
